state.description: Customer payments, created by transforming an invoice; each carries its applications.
Customer records; rowId is the NetSuite internal id. Balances are computed from transactions on read, never stored.
Read-only employees; backs the acting identity, the SuiteQL `employee` table and record audit fields.
Invoices, standalone or created from a sales order; amountRemaining is computed on read.
Inventory and service items; the inventoryItem endpoints expose only `inventoryItem` rows, SuiteQL `item` exposes both.
Per-transaction line sequence, so a removed line number is never reused within that transaction.
Row `account` (the simulated NetSuite account), row `counters` (entity/item/transaction id sequences) and row `limits` (scan and page bounds).
Read-only role definitions: permission levels and the role's subsidiary restriction ("0" = all).
Sales orders with their item sublist; status is derived from billed quantities.
Read-only OneWorld subsidiary hierarchy; rowId is the internal id.

operations.description: GET /services/rest/record/v1/customerPayment/{id} — read one customer payment record by internal id (permission TRAN_CUSTPYMT, view).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/customerPayment — list customer payment records as a NetSuite record collection, filtered by `q` and paged by limit/offset (permission TRAN_CUSTPYMT, view).
POST /services/rest/record/v1/customer — create a customer from a NetSuite wire body; answers 204 with a Location header (permission LIST_CUSTJOB, create).
DELETE /services/rest/record/v1/customer/{id} — delete a customer that no transaction references (permission LIST_CUSTJOB, full).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/customer/{id} — read one customer record by internal id (permission LIST_CUSTJOB, view).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/customer — list customer records as a NetSuite record collection, filtered by `q` and paged by limit/offset (permission LIST_CUSTJOB, view).
PATCH /services/rest/record/v1/customer/{id} — merge-patch a customer; `replace` clears the named fields first (permission LIST_CUSTJOB, edit).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/inventoryItem/{id} — read one inventory item record by internal id (permission LIST_ITEM, view).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/inventoryItem — list inventory item records as a NetSuite record collection, filtered by `q` and paged by limit/offset (permission LIST_ITEM, view).
POST /services/rest/record/v1/invoice — create a invoice from a NetSuite wire body; answers 204 with a Location header (permission TRAN_CUSTINVC, create).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/invoice/{id} — read one invoice record by internal id (permission TRAN_CUSTINVC, view).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/invoice — list invoice records as a NetSuite record collection, filtered by `q` and paged by limit/offset (permission TRAN_CUSTINVC, view).
POST /services/rest/record/v1/invoice/{id}/!transform/customerPayment — accept a customer payment against an invoice (permissions TRAN_CUSTINVC view and TRAN_CUSTPYMT create).
PATCH /services/rest/record/v1/invoice/{id} — merge-patch a invoice; `replace` clears the named fields first (permission TRAN_CUSTINVC, edit).

Read one record of any supported type by internal id, with sublists expanded; the argument shape matches the MCP Standard Tools ns_getRecord tool. The permission of the named record type is checked at view level.

mcp.name: ns_getRecord
mcp.description: Get a NetSuite record by record type and internal id.

operations.description: GET /services/rest/record/v1/metadata-catalog[/{recordType}] — list the supported record types, or describe one type's fields as an application/schema+json-shaped body derived from this Tool's own state schemas (permission SETUP_RECORD_METADATA, view). Also carries the account's server time.

mcp.name: ns_getRecordTypeMetadata
mcp.description: Describe the fields of a NetSuite record type, or list the supported record types.

operations.description: POST /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder — create a sales order from a NetSuite wire body; answers 204 with a Location header (permission TRAN_SALESORD, create).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id} — read one sales order record by internal id (permission TRAN_SALESORD, view).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id}/item — page the item sublist of one sales order (permission TRAN_SALESORD, view).
GET /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder — list sales order records as a NetSuite record collection, filtered by `q` and paged by limit/offset (permission TRAN_SALESORD, view).

POST /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id}/!transform/invoice — bill a sales order into an invoice, raising each billed line's quantityBilled (permissions TRAN_SALESORD view and TRAN_CUSTINVC create).
PATCH /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id} — merge-patch a sales order; `replace` clears the named fields first (permission TRAN_SALESORD, edit).

The signed-in SuiteTalk session: account, employee, role with its permission levels, subsidiary scope and the account server time. NetSuite exposes this through its application shell rather than a REST resource, so this operation has no HTTP route; it is what the browser app reads to render the account/role chrome and to date every screen from world time (permission SETUP_RECORD_METADATA, view).

GET /services/rest/record/v1/subsidiary — list the account's subsidiaries (permission LIST_SUBSIDIARY, view). The REST route answers a record collection; the canonical/MCP shape carries the full subsidiary objects.

mcp.name: ns_getSubsidiaries
mcp.description: List the subsidiaries defined in this NetSuite account.

operations.description: POST /services/rest/query/v1/suiteql — run one read-only SELECT over the analytics tables customer, transaction, transactionLine, item, employee and subsidiary. Requires the Prefer: transient header and permission REPO_ANALYTICS, view. Every scalar is rendered as a JSON string, as NetSuite does.
Run a read-only SuiteQL SELECT and return the rows directly; the argument shape matches the MCP Standard Tools ns_runCustomSuiteQL tool (permission REPO_ANALYTICS, view).

mcp.name: ns_runCustomSuiteQL
mcp.description: Run a read-only SuiteQL SELECT statement and return the resulting rows.
